# Alex Cutrupi .
Year 11 student exploring electrical installation and engineering, networking and IT infrastructure.

## About me
I’m a passionate and self-motivated individual with a strong interest in electrical engineering, software development and technology. I started programming at 12 and learning about electrical systems at 13.
I enjoy building practical projects, solving technical problems and developing new skills independently. I also have basic plumbing experience. My ambition is to pursue a career in electrical installation and engineering while continuing to explore software development and industrial automation.
I have a strong interest in railways, particularly trains, railway signalling, infrastructure and the control systems that ensure safe and efficient railway operations. I also travel independently across the UK by rail, planning journeys with multiple connections and adapting when there’s disruption.
**Electrical & controls**
Installation, lighting and electronics
**Networking & servers**
Cabling, Linux and infrastructure
**Software & automation**
Web, scripting and smart homes
Explore my skills Education & career

# Projects
My work on customer loyalty cards, Linux hosting and hands-on building.
Customer loyalty

## Pistopass
I’m building Pistopass to give businesses a simple way to run loyalty card programmes and reward customers for coming back.
**Period**
November 2026 – Present
Hosting & IT infrastructure

## BlastHost
A hosting platform linked to InstantBay for services such as Minecraft servers. I worked on the servers, networking and website.
**Period**
July 2025 – January 2026
**Role**
Servers, networking & website

### What I did

#### Linux servers
Set up a physical Debian server and Ubuntu VPSs, installed services, managed permissions and troubleshot startup issues.
Tools: Debian, Ubuntu, UFW

#### Game hosting panel
Ran Pterodactyl for game servers and customised its Laravel-based panel for BlastHost.
Tools: Pterodactyl, Laravel

#### Website
Built the site in Next.js and deployed it on Linux behind Nginx, managed by systemd.
Tools: Next.js, Node.js, Nginx, systemd

#### Networking & email
Linked home servers to a VPS with WireGuard, worked with routing, NAT and port forwarding, and set up a mail server with TLS.
Tools: WireGuard, OpenVPN, Postfix, Dovecot
Linux administration Networking Web development Problem-solving
Hands-on building

## Home network & room build
Practical building and wiring work at home: framing and boarding walls, running power and network cabling, wiring lights, and setting up a rack, patch panel and Wi-Fi.
**Period**
April 2024 – Present

### The build in photos
- Boxing-in plastered and painted · Nov 2026
Electrical wiring Structured cabling Networking hardware Carpentry Plasterboard

# Skills & knowledge
What I’ve been learning over the past three years, mostly by building things at home.

## Practical skills

### Plastering
Boarding, preparing surfaces, and plastering and finishing walls.

### Woodworking
Measuring, cutting and joining timber for stud walls and shelving.
See it in my home build

## Electrical & lighting
Self-directed study

### Electrical systems
- Single- and three-phase installation layouts
- Consumer units, protection and isolation
- Drawing distribution layouts to balance phases and loads
Learning & experimenting

### Lighting & control
- DMX and Art-Net universes and fixture addressing
- Show programming in QLC+

## Networking & IT

### Networks & cabling
- Ethernet cable routing and termination
- Wi-Fi access points and managed switches
- VLANs and fibre connections

### Linux & servers
- Linux server setup and remote administration
- Hosting and domain configuration

### Code & automation
- Python and shell scripting
- Working with APIs
- Home Assistant automations

### Computers & hardware
- PC building and upgrades
- Hardware troubleshooting

## Personal qualities
What my projects show, rather than what I’d just claim.
Independent learning · Research
I taught myself Linux, networking and electrical theory at home, and researched Electrical Installation Levels 1–3 and apprenticeship routes. Career goals
Technical problem-solving · Logical thinking · Troubleshooting · Persistence
On BlastHost I worked through failing builds, mail logins and services that wouldn’t start, using logs to find the cause. BlastHost
Practical ability · Attention to detail
I framed, boarded and plastered walls and ran tidy power and network cabling in my home build. Home build
Project planning · Systems thinking
I plan how the parts connect, from cable routes through a room to distribution layouts that balance phases and loads.
Initiative · Entrepreneurial thinking · Creativity
I started Pistopass to help businesses reward returning customers, and customised BlastHost’s game panel to fit the brand. Pistopass
Adaptability · Technical curiosity
I move between software, networking and hands-on building, and keep trying new things like DMX lighting and Home Assistant.
Independence · Journey planning · Time management
I travel independently across the UK by rail: planning journeys with several trains and connections, finding another route when services are delayed or cancelled, and keeping costs down with split tickets and off-peak fares.

## Career goals
I’m aiming for a career in electrical installation and engineering. I’ve researched Electrical Installation Levels 1–3, apprenticeships and how people progress in the trade.
I also want to keep building my networking and IT experience, because modern buildings need both.
